subject: health

location.courseTitle: Health II: Mental Health and Community Wellness

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the private-safe task without disclosing medical history, diagnosis, body measurements, or sexual history.
Use a fictional scenario when offered and identify a trusted adult or qualified professional where appropriate.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain assertive communication versus passive and aggressive patterns in your own words and give a valid example.
Use a cited source, diagram, model, or documented process to show understanding of de-escalation language and body positioning.
Apply conflict resolution and repair after a rupture in a new fictional situation. Show the decision process or cite the evidence used.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, or unsafe choice involving bullying, harassment, and hazing: recognition and reporting; correct it and explain why.
Connect warning signs of escalating violence and when to leave with reporting pathways and what happens after a report. Explain how the two support, constrain, or build on one another.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Take one fictional conflict from first friction to three different endings — repaired, disengaged, and reported — and justify which ending fits which conditions.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy of health information criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill application criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. No assessment requires disclosure, a recording, or any body measurement.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Communication, Conflict, and Violence Prevention?
